intro: I dropped it... The fuel receipt! While I was running from the Admin building earlier!
The digital scan on the office drive is cut off—without that physical paper, the story falls apart!
I have to text Kiko—'Bleachers... basketball court... left it near—'
Battery at one percent?! No, no, no—not now...!
outro: Seriously... Why does Enzo always find a way to drag me into his messes?
First, he botches the upload and almost gets us expelled for an alleged 'data breach'...
...and now he drops the only physical receipt on the bleachers and lets his phone die on one percent?!
I'm supposed to be just a junior encoder, not his full-time cleanup crew.
At least the paper trail is finally secured. If he loses this again, I'm taping it to his forehead.
